notes.note: Reviewed the final instruction and ActionRow delta after source fixes. Equivalent shell app/server commands now reuse the existing ActionRow owner, preserving canApply/staged-flow conditions, scope/identity authority, pending disables and restart confirmation; only ordering/wrapping/gaps are shared. The instruction explicitly limits shell recipes to src-ui and preserves published-package imports for pane packages. Field/Select remain published controls; no token/theme values, API/native permissions, update policies or underlying install mechanisms changed. The 221-test focused update batch passed, and 103 core/connection/scope tests passed after row adoption. Captures retain controlled-state/non-native qualification limits. This covers the changed claims and instruction route without claiming application-wide migration or provider completion.
